supporting_frequency_control.role: A first-replication seed-2 child-B FRT50000 model printed next random failure time 12.9322 at h8. It is a prediction cue only, not an accepted outcome or general rate-scaling proof.

source.rule: Lowest-level linked subsystems carry direct repair and preventive maintenance. A child failure can interrupt operation of the deployed composite; the event log must locate the effect before any sibling-stop claim.

configuration.child_a_calendar_pm: CAL24, one hour, unchanged from accepted parent

pre_run_hypothesis: The first seed-2 mission should experience at least one directly repairable linked-child failure during h8–10 under FRT500000. The supporting FRT50000 control prints a prospective failure h12.9322 when exposure begins h8, making a within-first-mission failure plausible but not guaranteed by a source-derived exact-time law.

Native events should identify the deployed composite mission impact, the failing child or repair target if exposed, a corrective maintenance start/completion at BASE-01, and the unchanged child-A CAL24 PM. Record the actual event order/timestamps and resource/stock effects; do not infer an internal sibling timeline absent a separate native identifier.
Report SystemResults, StockTotalResults, ResultSummary and terminal readiness must reconcile with the event log; a nonempty report alone is insufficient.
native_acceptance: Guarded session-0 SSH import/export, calculation, report export, 22 populated authored-table exact roundtrip, and GUI PID13340/host mutex/registry/source continuity.
Zero converter errors/notes, all warnings individually classified, valid nonempty SXO/event log/report and 120 half-hour System/Stock bins.
At least one child-B failure and bounded leaf corrective maintenance event and at least one child-A CAL24 PM event; actual mission impact and terminal metrics traced against raw evidence.
Separate read-only reviewer replays source delta, raw seals, event chronology, ledgers and terminal state without importing author validation.
diagnostic_gate: If native output rejects the input or does not expose the required child failure/leaf CM/PM chain, retain the sealed run as diagnostic and do not publish this positive scope. Revise under a new candidate version and run ID before any further native attempt.
limits: One composite, two linked children, one nonzero child-B rate, one station, one seed and one replication. No rate inference or population claim follows; G12.var02 separately covers aggregate frequency contrasts.
The event log may name the top deployed system rather than the internal child. Source-bound attribution is not physical target observation unless the log exposes it.
Wrong-level repair/PM, other child types, resources, stocked items, GUI visuals, cross-engine behavior and general sibling outage remain unverified.
